extra_payroll_tax.name: New York Paid Family Leave (PFL)
extra_payroll_tax.note: Mandatory employee payroll deduction, 0.432% of wages in 2026, capped at $411.91/year. Funds paid family leave benefits — separate from income tax.

source.agency_name: NYS Department of Taxation and Finance (IT-201 instructions) / City of Yonkers Code, Article IX
source.note: NYC resident brackets cross-checked against two independent secondary sources 2026-07-29; Yonkers 16.75% resident surcharge (of net NY state tax) is a long-standing, unindexed statutory figure, cross-checked against a second secondary source the same day.

local_tax_note: This estimate now computes New York City resident tax (3.078%-3.876% brackets) and the Yonkers resident surcharge (16.75% of net NY state tax) when selected above. Not covered: Yonkers non-resident earnings tax (a separate levy on people who work, but don't live, in Yonkers) and the Metropolitan Commuter Transportation Mobility Tax (MCTMT) on self-employment income — neither is modeled here.
deviation_note: This is an estimate based on standard single-filer federal, FICA, NY state tax, and NY PFL calculations. Actual withholding may differ based on your W-4/IT-2104 elections, pre-tax deductions, NYC/Yonkers tax, and other factors.
